name: Darius Antoine Brooks
justification: I might try it once, since I eat vegetables and am open to different foods, but I’m not sure I’d buy it regularly. I usually prefer a filling, well-seasoned meal, and I’d want to see the price and how it tastes.

name: Megan Kathleen Doyle
justification: I might try it, especially if there was a small bottle or a good deal, but cold blended vegetables aren’t usually what I reach for. I’d be curious, just not sure I’d buy it regularly.

name: Elena Marquez
justification: I might try bottled gazpacho if it tasted fresh and was reasonably priced, especially for a quick lunch. But cold soup isn’t usually what I reach for, so I’m not sure I’d buy it regularly.

name: Terrence Malik Johnson
justification: I’m very unlikely to buy it. I prefer familiar, mild foods, and cold blended vegetables aren’t something I usually reach for; I’d want to know the ingredients and flavor before considering a bottle.

name: Rafael Ignacio Cárdenas
justification: I’d try a bottle, especially chilled on a hot Houston day, since I enjoy trying regional foods. But gazpacho depends on freshness and texture, and I’m not sure a bottled version would taste lively, so I wouldn’t count on buying it regularly.
